Freshworks

freshworks... the saas unicorn that's actually making money. solid.

Yes
over at freshworks... that's the saas company that actually figured out profitable growth while everyone else was burning cash. what do you do there?
Senior SDET

senior sdet at freshworks... so you're the one making sure their product doesn't crash when customers actually use it. quality engineering is where the real heroes live - everyone wants features fast, but you're the one keeping the lights on.

how long you been working total?

9.5 years... that's solid experience. you've seen enough broken code to write a book about it.

what kind of role you looking for next?
SDET, Lead SDET

sdet or lead sdet... smart. staying in your lane but leveling up. quality engineering pays well and there's always demand for people who actually know how to break things properly.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?

Bangalore and remote both works.
Even delhi NCR is fine

34LPA

Atleast

  Cool

so you're at freshworks making 34 LPA, want 40+, 30 days notice, 9.5 years experience... and you're looking to leave. what's the real reason? just growth or something else?
Growth

growth meaning you want to lead bigger projects? move into management? or just want more complex technical challenges?

what does growth actually look like for you day to day?
And salary

growth + salary... that's the real combo. you want both - bigger challenges AND better pay.

makes sense. 9.5 years in, you've earned it.

i'm scanning for senior/lead sdet roles that actually pay 40+ and have real growth potential. not just title inflation.

anything specific you're avoiding? certain companies, industries, team sizes?
No

cool. you're open to anything that pays 40+ and has real growth.

i'll keep an eye out for senior/lead sdet roles that actually match that.

It is no longer accepting the applications so not able to apply

but that's fine - there are plenty of other tier 1 companies looking for senior quality engineers. microsoft, google, uber, swiggy, zomato all have big QA teams.

what's your location preference? bangalore, delhi ncr, or remote?
Anything is fine

got it. flexible on location - bangalore, delhi ncr, or remote all work.

i'm scanning for senior/lead sdet roles that pay 40+ and have real growth potential. tier 1 companies mostly.

anything else i should know about what you're looking for? team culture, tech stack preferences, anything like that?

And i am ok with companies that are not even in tier 1
  No

okay so you're open to tier 1, tier 2, whatever - as long as it pays 40+ and has growth.

that actually gives me more to work with. sometimes the best growth opportunities are at scaling companies, not just the giants.

i'll keep scanning. anything matching your profile, i'll slide it.

btw... what got you into quality engineering in the first place?
Started as qa only

started as qa and worked your way up to senior sdet... that's the classic path. you've seen the whole evolution from manual testing to automation to now potentially leadership.

most people who start in qa either get stuck or pivot to dev. you stuck with it and leveled up.

respect.
